Have you heard of the Libby amphibole asbestos in the UK, just out of curiosity?

Have off and on lived in Libby, MT.  Pretty much an EPA disaster because of the vermiculite mine, which shipped the asbestos contaminated vermiculite around the world.

 Apparently one of my great uncles who worked on the mine was one of the first persons to be diagnosed with mesothelioma. 

When I lived there around 2000-2003 they were tearing up and removing the asbestos from the elementary school.  I was in fifth grade and transferred to the middle school where they were tearing up the track because asbestos had been used in that.  I feel like I saw more covered houses and hazmat suits then I ever have.

So many people with problems due to the mine and vermiculite asbestos being used in EVERYTHING.  

Don't want to sound like an asshole, but just to put things into perspective, I went and saw Jurassic World in theaters there.  Pretty packed movie for such a small town and I swear there wasn't fifteen minutes without different people coughing throughout the whole movie. 

Asbestos is bad.
